items.title: GPT-6 rolls out in ChatGPT with 'Intelligent UI'
items.summary_en: According to OpenAI's pages as surfaced by search, GPT-6 began rolling out in ChatGPT with an interface that can combine text, visuals and interactive tools such as calculators in answers. Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users get GPT-6 Sol first; Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna starting the following day.

items.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna October 2026 safety update classifies models as High capability in cyber and bio/chem
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Deployment Safety Hub update says it is treating the October release of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as High capability in both Cybersecurity and Biological and Chemical domains. A PDF version is also listed.

items.title: Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol arrives in the Responses API
items.summary_en: OpenAI release notes reportedly state that ultrafast mode is available for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API to all API users, subject to rate limits. It supports global processing and US and EU data residency.

items.title: Codex beta: composer predictions suggest next message
items.summary_en: A beta Codex feature called composer predictions suggests the user's next message in a thread. It is limited to personal ChatGPT Pro users for now.
